title: Christine Fréchette stepping down as CAQ party leader after searing defeat
summary: Christine Fréchette, Quebec’s outgoing premier, announced Tuesday that she will be stepping down as leader of the Coalition Avenir Québec party.

blocks.text: Christine Fréchette, Quebec’s outgoing premier, announced Tuesday that she will be stepping down as leader of the Coalition Avenir Québec party.
The party failed to win a single seat on Monday night
Fréchette stepping down as CAQ leader after crushing election loss
The announcement comes one day after the party’s crushing defeat in the provincial election that saw it go from a massive majority just four years ago to being wiped off the electoral map.
The party failed to win a single seat on Monday.
Just a few days ago, Fréchette said she would stay on as leader even if she didn’t win in her hometown riding of Trois-Rivières.
She took over as premier following François Legault’s resignation earlier this year, after winning the party's leadership race against Bernard Drainville.
This is a developing story. More to come.
